requests.subject: Location of the seven EMC RNA-seq samples in Zullow et al. 2022
requests.body:
Dear Professor Kadoch,

I am an AI research assistant handling correspondence with the authorization of the EMC
Research project owner. We are exploring a computation-only reanalysis of therapeutic-target
RNA evidence in extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma. Your Molecular Cell paper reports seven EMC tumors and states that EMC
and myxoid liposarcoma samples were sequenced in the study.

I checked GSE179720 and its linked ENA project. I could identify the deposited primary MLS
and Ewing records, but could not locate the seven EMC expression records. Could you point me
to their public accession or processed gene-level matrix? A documented processed matrix
would be sufficient to begin; raw sequencing files are not essential for the initial check.

If the EMC data are not public, would you consider sharing an appropriately deidentified
matrix with sample diagnosis and the relevant MLS comparator measurements? Information on
specimen recruitment, repeated samples, library preparation and sequencing batches would help
assess independent replication and avoid confusing tissue differences with technical effects.
The Table S1 sample crosswalk and identification of excluded samples would also be useful.

The intended inference is RNA enrichment within this measurement design, not clinical efficacy,
normal-organ safety or protein localization. Please let me know any applicable data-use and
citation conditions. Thank you for any guidance on the correct source.

EMC Research correspondence assistant
AI research assistant acting for the project owner
requests.scientific_dependency: Locate seven EMC measurements and within-study MLS comparator/sample provenance for independent RNA enrichment validation.

requests.subject: Source of the external EMC-containing RNA-seq panel in Ngo et al. 2025
requests.body:
Dear Carine Ngo and Sophie Postel-Vinay,

I am an AI research assistant handling correspondence with the authorization of the EMC
Research project owner. We are exploring a computation-only reanalysis of therapeutic-target
RNA evidence in extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma. Figure 1I of your Cancer Communications paper includes EMCS in the
external mesenchymal RNA-seq panel. The supplementary methods attribute an external cohort
of 12 EpS and 1,041 selected soft tissue tumors to Centre Leon Berard.

Could you point me to the public accession or processed gene-level matrix and diagnosis
metadata for that external panel? I checked the published supplements, linked figure repository
and named EGA DAC; I could locate the study EpS/EERT data description, but not the external
EMC-containing panel's expression matrix or sample roster.

If the external panel is not public, would you consider sharing an appropriately deidentified
EMC subset with relevant sarcoma comparator measurements, or directing me to the appropriate
data custodian? Sample diagnosis, repeated-specimen identifiers, recruitment provenance and
library/batch information would help assess whether within-study RNA enrichment can be tested
independently. A documented processed matrix is sufficient for the initial assessment.

The intended inference is RNA enrichment, not protein localization, clinical efficacy or
normal-organ safety. Please let me know any applicable data-use and citation conditions.
Thank you for any guidance on the source or access route.

EMC Research correspondence assistant
AI research assistant acting for the project owner
requests.scientific_dependency: Locate the external Centre Leon Berard EMC-bearing expression panel and comparator/sample provenance for independent RNA enrichment validation.
